capabilities: import a UTF-8 CSV or TSV glossary file up to 4 MiB
map term and meaning columns in a preview
look up the selected term with exact matching and case control
insert a chosen meaning at the original selection
manage multiple glossary profiles and search across them
extras: Freemium: core features are free; Pro (multiple profiles, multi-glossary search) requires a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship, with sign-in via the GitHub device flow and offline Pro for up to 14 days. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later. After updates it opens a 'What's new' tab that promotes other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat; the repository ships no updater and recommends backing up the source glossary and note. Free tier uses the first stored profile; other profiles remain saved but inactive.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up a selected term in a local glossary file and insert its meaning into the note.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: Glossary lookup plugin that finds meanings for a selected term in an imported CSV or TSV file and inserts the chosen sense into the note.
